spans.s: मैत्र (I) a. (f. त्री) 1. Friendly, amicable, well-disposed, Bg.xii.13; 2. given by a friend; 3. belonging to a friend; 4. relating to the god Mitra, K.S.viii.6.
मैत्र (II) m. 1. A particular mixed caste; 2. a Brāhmaṇa; 3. the anus.
मैत्र (III) n. 1. Friendship; 2. evacuation of excrement; 3. the constellation Anurādhā.
